programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Mediación, Gestión y Difusión Musical
institution: Musikene - Centro Superior de Música del País Vasco (San Sebastián)
discovery_source: institution site enumeration (https://www.musikene.eus/, accessed 2026-08-24)
notes: DISTINCT OFFICIAL CATEGORY - read carefully. This is a MASTER EN ENSENANZAS ARTISTICAS: an official Spanish qualification, MECES level 3 / EQF level 7, with 'academic and professional validity throughout Spanish territory', homologated by the Ministry of Education with a Certificado de Homologacion de Master published in the BOE. It is NOT a master universitario (it is awarded by a higher artistic education centre, not a university) and it will NOT appear in RUCT, which registers university titles - so absence from RUCT here is NOT evidence against officiality. Spanish law treats masteres en ensenanzas artisticas as equivalent to masteres universitarios; PhD access is generally possible but is granted case by case by the doctoral school - VERIFY explicitly before relying on it. UNUSUALLY 120 ECTS over 2 years (most Spanish masters are 60/1yr). Fee EUR 3,900 for a full 60-ECTS enrolment year, stated for 2026/2027, payable in three instalments; 15% discount for Musikene alumni => approx. EUR 7,800 total for the 120 ECTS. Modality: SEMI-PRESENCIAL (blended online + in-person) - a meaningful advantage. LANGUAGE: group classes in SPANISH; individual sessions in a language agreed with the tutor; English recommended for bibliography. Entry: Grado or equivalent higher artistic qualification; explicitly open to non-music graduates (Psychology, Education, Social Work cited) - so a software engineer is plausibly admissible; selection by merit assessment, no entrance exam. Field P/S: music mediation, management and dissemination. Non-EU surcharge: NOT FOUND. 300-ECTS advanced standing: NOT FOUND.
validating_university: None - awarded by Musikene as an official higher artistic education centre (Gobierno Vasco); homologation certificate published in BOE

programme_name: Máster en Industria Musical 360 (Máster de Formación Permanente en Industria Musical, 60 ECTS, por UDIMA)
institution: SAE Institute Spain (campuses: Madrid and Barcelona)
discovery_source: institution site enumeration (https://www.sae.edu/esp/sae-home/ course index, accessed 2026-08-24)
notes: THE TITULO PROPIO TRAP IN ITS PUREST FORM. Marketed as 'Master en Industria Musical'. The page actually offers TWO parallel awards plus a school diploma: (1) 'Master Profesional en Industria Musical acreditado por UDIMA' - open to people with only 2 years' professional experience, i.e. not a degree-gated qualification at all; (2) 'Master en Formacion Permanente en Industria Musical, 60 ECTS, acreditado por UDIMA' - degree-gated. 'Master de Formacion Permanente' is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a UNIVERSITY'S OWN TITLE (titulo propio). It is NOT a master universitario, is NOT ANECA-verified, will NOT be in RUCT, and gives NO PhD access. UDIMA (Universidad a Distancia de Madrid) is a private university lending its name; SAE delivers. Duration 12 months. Modality: FULLY IN-PERSON ('integramente presenciales'). Campuses Madrid and Barcelona. LANGUAGE: Spanish AND English, high proficiency required in both (per entry requirements) - unusual and worth noting. PRICE: NOT PUBLISHED on the site. Entry for the 60-ECTS route: official university degree (Grado/Licenciatura/Ingenieria/Arquitectura/Diplomatura or equivalent). Non-EU surcharge: NOT FOUND. Advanced standing for 300 ECTS: NOT FOUND.
validating_university: UDIMA - Universidad a Distancia de Madrid (accredits/issues; SAE Institute delivers)
